verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions/CI-CD is the obvious mechanism for event-triggered automation, and the pack gestures at it ('Extend your stack with apps, actions, and AI models', 'Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD'), but there is no concrete documentation of defining trigger rules (on push/issue/PR events) or AI-native usage of them in this evidence set. missing for 10: explicit workflow/trigger syntax documentation, AI-native example of defining event rules, independent corroboration of automation depth.
